items.title: @rohanpaul_ai：New Google paper shows that autonomous AI research can go badly wrong even when the final paper looks convincing: severe
items.abstract_or_text: New Google paper shows that autonomous AI research can go badly wrong even when the final paper looks convincing: severe result hallucinations appeared in 90% of Agent Laboratory papers and 46% of Co-Scientist papers when its reliability modules were removed. items.title: @drfeifei：I'm so excited that our @theworldlabs team has achieved a major milestone today! Introducing Atlas - a first of its kind
items.abstract_or_text: I'm so excited that our @theworldlabs team has achieved a major milestone today! Introducing Atlas - a first of its kind multimodal world model trained from scratch! 🚀 Atlas is capable of generating frames with pixel-perfect camera control, reconstructing large scenes from as few as one single input image, simulating space-time by reframing videos, natively outputting 3D spaces from one or more input images, composing multiple posed images into a consistent 3d world, and more! This is the best camera conditioned world model ever, opening doors to many possible use cases from VFX to robotics. I'm so so so proud of our team!♥️

items.title: @sama：Over the summer, we have been sprinting on safety priorities; it's more important than ever for capabilities and safegua
items.abstract_or_text: Over the summer, we have been sprinting on safety priorities; it's more important than ever for capabilities and safeguards to advance together. We have more to do but have made a lot of progress. We are also going to be launching our next model soon. There is an obvious tension here: on one hand, Astra is very good and we are excited to see what people will build with it. We are proud of our work. On the other hand, we are clearly in a phase of development where we believe caution is warranted, and we are pacing our progress to ensure that we can meet the safety standards required by new capability levels. Astra has been done training for a while now and is a significant step forward in both capabilities and alignment. For the models after that, we have been slowing things as needed to ensure that we can do sufficient work on safety and alignment.

items.title: @dair_ai：Banger paper from the Qwen team. If you evaluate agents on anything longer than a single session, this one is worth your
items.abstract_or_text: Banger paper from the Qwen team. If you evaluate agents on anything longer than a single session, this one is worth your time. E-Commerce Bench runs an agent through a simulated 365-day year operating several online stores at once. 18 frontier models are scored across seven dimensions and no single model dominates. GPT-5.6 Sol earns the most, growing a 100,000 opening stake into 1,431,425, then ranks 16th of 18 on fraud avoidance and trails Fable 5 on operational efficiency. Among open-weight models, Qwen3.8-Max-Preview leads at 416,252, 38% above GLM 5.2 (high), and shows the strongest learning over the horizon by progressively bargaining suppliers down across repeated orders.

items.title: @lanyon_ai：Formally verified magnetohydrodynamics, with provably hyperbolicity-preserving magnetic divergence error correction. Sim
items.abstract_or_text: Formally verified magnetohydrodynamics, with provably hyperbolicity-preserving magnetic divergence error correction. Simulating plasma vortices and supersonic plasma flows in arbitrary geometries using shock-capturing schemes for the equations of ideal MHD, all implemented and verified autonomously with Lanyon. ~32,000 lines of C, ~50,000 lines of Lean proof, ~150 correctness theorems, all generated in ~7 minutes. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first ever fully formally verified divergence correction scheme for the MHD equations.

items.title: @BiologyAIDaily：A Medicinal Chemistry-Centered Evaluation of AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 Across Diverse Binding Modalities The study benchma
items.abstract_or_text: A Medicinal Chemistry-Centered Evaluation of AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 Across Diverse Binding Modalities The study benchmarks AlphaFold 3 (AF3) and Boltz-2 for medicinal-chemistry use cases (lead optimization, SAR interpretation, virtual screening), emphasizing that “pose correctness” is not just whole-ligand RMSD but also whether key recognition features are preserved. A curated post-training-cutoff benchmark (PDB entries released after 2021-09-30) plus newly determined in-house soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) co-crystals is assembled across modalities: kinases, orthosteric enzymes, allosteric modulators, PPI inhibitors, PROTACs, molecular glues, covalent systems, membrane proteins, RNA binders, fragments, and activity-cliff pairs.
